# Security and Integrity

- Verify issuer authenticity against the official registry, mint authority, and approved issuer records.
- Accept blockchain identifiers only after independent authentication and verification.
- Use strong idempotency and immutable audit events for settlement simulations.
- Separate reference data from executable order-routing paths.
- Keep trading and signing disabled in this preview.
- Reject private keys and credentials in any public repository or pull request.
- Display data freshness and listing status at the point of use.
